Insert a wallet movement for the business. Requires the **secret key**. `wallettransactiontypeid` 2 = Debit only — **Credit is admin-only** (`99` otherwise). `walletfundmodeid` 1/2/3; manual adjustments use 2 (Back Office). `createdby` is optional (numeric user id; defaults to the business's primary user).
